## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #

---

## 📝 Summary

Updates `docs/docs/api/plugin-bindings-api.md` to reflect the `plugin_id` refactor shipped in #4286:

- `plugin_id` is now a plain string (plugin class name) rather than a constrained enum — the doc has been updated throughout to match
- Old enum values (`OUTPUT_LENGTH_GUARD`, `RATE_LIMITER`, `SECRETS_DETECTION`) replaced with class names (`OutputLengthGuardPlugin`, `RateLimiterPlugin`, `SecretsDetection`) in all tables, JSON snippets, curl examples, and error message examples
- Supported-plugins table restructured: removed the redundant "Plugin class name" column, added a clarifying note that `plugin_id` is the class name registered in `config.yaml`
- Added `SQLSanitizer` to the supported-plugins table with a full config reference section (field descriptions + curl example)

---
